title: Lienholder Loss Payee and Claim Adjustment on Manufactured Home Insurance
content:
Two servicing features are fixed across every Manufactured Home Insurance form.

| Policy form | A lienholder may be named loss payee | The agency adjusts claims itself |
|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | Yes | No |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | Yes | No |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | Yes | No |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | Yes | No |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | Yes | No |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | Yes | No |

- **Loss payee.** On every form a lienholder on the home may be named loss payee on the policy.
- **Claims.** Hearthstone Insurance Agency does not adjust claims on any form: claims are reported to and adjusted by the carrier.
